clock_freshness_policy: Requires a documented source update/event timestamp; HTTP Date and receipt time do not substitute.
missing_clock_policy: Capture observations but mark decision eligibility/freshness unverified; no paper fills or strategy results.
settlement_policy: Record official finalized/settled yes/no results only; no proxy payout or assumed settlement.
resume_policy: Only integrity-verified exact preceding handoff in the same workflow attempt; no older-checkpoint fallback or automatic rerun.
stage_2_policy: Not launched automatically. Requires a separate fully frozen prospective protocol and verified readiness.
